title: 2018 AHA/ACC/AACVPR/AAPA/ABC/ACPM/ADA/AGS/APhA/ASPC/NLA/PCNA Guideline on the Management of Blood Cholesterol

definitions.ASCVD: Atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease: ACS, MI, stable/unstable angina, coronary or other arterial revascularization, stroke, TIA, PAD
definitions.Very High Risk ASCVD: ≥2 major ASCVD events OR 1 major event + ≥2 high-risk conditions
definitions.Statin Intolerance: Inability to tolerate ≥2 statins due to skeletal muscle or other adverse effects
definitions.FH: Familial hypercholesterolemia: LDL-C ≥190 mg/dL without secondary cause

recommendations.text: In patients with clinical ASCVD, high-intensity statin therapy is recommended to reduce LDL-C by ≥50%.
In very-high-risk ASCVD with LDL-C ≥70 mg/dL on maximally tolerated statin, ezetimibe is recommended.
In very-high-risk ASCVD with LDL-C ≥70 mg/dL on maximally tolerated statin + ezetimibe, PCSK9 inhibitor addition is recommended.
Adults 40–75 years with LDL-C 70–189 mg/dL and ≥7.5% 10-year ASCVD risk: moderate-to-high intensity statin is recommended.
In adults 40–75 years with LDL-C ≥190 mg/dL, high-intensity statin therapy is recommended without prior risk assessment.
For adults with diabetes aged 40–75 years with LDL-C 70–189 mg/dL, moderate-intensity statin is recommended regardless of ASCVD risk.
A risk discussion including risk enhancers should be held before initiating statin therapy in adults with borderline or intermediate risk.
Coronary artery calcium (CAC) score may be used to guide statin therapy decisions in intermediate-risk adults.
Icosapent ethyl 4 g/day is recommended for patients with established CVD or DM with triglycerides 150–499 mg/dL on statin therapy.
Bempedoic acid is recommended for adults with ASCVD or FH who cannot tolerate statins, to reduce LDL-C.
Inclisiran (siRNA targeting PCSK9) is recommended for additional LDL-C lowering in ASCVD patients with LDL-C ≥70 mg/dL on maximally tolerated therapy.

pharmacotherapy.indication: Add-on to statin in ASCVD LDL ≥70

pharmacotherapy.examples: evolocumab 140 mg Q2wk or 420 mg monthly; alirocumab 75–150 mg Q2wk
pharmacotherapy.indication: Very-high-risk ASCVD/FH on max statin + ezetimibe

pharmacotherapy.examples: inclisiran 284 mg SC at day 1, 3 months, then Q6months
pharmacotherapy.indication: Secondary prevention LDL ≥70 on max therapy
